# Lists

## Unordered Lists

- Item with dash
- Another item

* Item with asterisk
* Another item

+ Item with plus
+ Another item

## Ordered Lists

1. First item
2. Second item
3. Third item

1. Auto-numbered
1. Items
1. Work too

## Nested Lists

- Level 1
  - Level 2
    - Level 3
      - Level 4
        - Level 5

## Mixed Nesting

1. Ordered parent
   - Unordered child
   - Another child
     1. Nested ordered
     2. Another ordered
2. Back to ordered
   * With asterisk child
   + And plus child
